status: Independent native-source visual review only; no camera/model fitting, Blender or production edits.
source_identity: Same BV169Y96rEo1 P1 replay, same double-strapped rolled cloth object. Not a new/later replay.
sufficient_for: Small shared-object conditional silhouette/tilt correction with source cameras and all other objects frozen; test both images simultaneously and retain uncertainty.
insufficient_for: Rigid vertex triangulation from silhouette extrema or band midpoints
shared_end_identity: Upper end is identifiable as the same free rounded end above the upper strap in both frames. Its visible arc is view-dependent, so matching arc samples one-to-one is invalid. Lower end remains partially occluded in both.
suggested_C06_protocol: Treat outline distance or region occupancy and broad axis direction as soft evidence, not exact 3D correspondences. Keep cameras/other props fixed. Preserve C05 comparison and report new geometry as a conditional candidate. Avoid restoring an elevated false bottom merely to align top. Ground support is a separate inferred constraint and may require joint center/tilt/length adjustment, not entire-group translation.

annotation_legend.cyan: visible upper external outline approximate samples ±5px
annotation_legend.magenta: soft midpoint cue ±8px and connecting direction, NOT measured axis
annotation_legend.red: occluded/uncertain lower zone; no true bottom inferred

semantics.upper_outline: Hand-observed external soft-cloth silhouette, NOT cap-plane perimeter or material-matched vertices across views. Approximate polyline, not pixel segmentation.
semantics.bands: Same upper/lower red straps identified across views. Listed endpoints are visible silhouette/curve extrema, NOT identical material points across views.
semantics.soft_midpoints: 2D cue formed from visible band extent, may be biased by perspective/curvature; NOT measured 3D axis projections. Use only low-weight direction/region evidence.
semantics.lower_region: Visible cloth only. True end-cap center, lowest point and ground contact obscured by grass/chair/rope; unknown, no extrapolated corner.
